title: Double Criticality for a Hardy-Rellich Biharmonic Heat Equation in an Exterior Domain
summary: We study the existence and nonexistence of weak solutions to an inhomogeneous semilinear biharmonic heat equation in an exterior domain, involving a singular Hardy--Rellich potential, a weighted nonlinearity $|x|^σ|u|^{p}$, and a positive source term $f(x)$. We identify two distinct critical regimes governing the behavior of solutions. More precisely, we first determine a Fujita-type critical exponent that separates nonexistence from existence.
